name: findDelegation.py - Enumerate AD Delegation Settings
description: Impacket findDelegation enumerates all delegation settings in Active Directory: unconstrained, constrained, and resource-based constrained delegation. Shows which accounts can impersonate others and to which services. Critical first step before any delegation-based attack (S4U2Self/Proxy, RBCD, printer bug).
source: Impacket; HTB machines; CRTP delegation module
notes:
=== BASIC USAGE ===
  findDelegation.py <domain>/<user>:<pass> -dc-ip <dc_ip>
  # Shows: AccountName, AccountType, DelegationType, DelegationRightsTo

=== OUTPUT COLUMNS ===
  # AccountName: The account with delegation
  # AccountType: User or Computer
  # DelegationType: Unconstrained, Constrained, Resource-Based Constrained
  # DelegationRightsTo: Target service(s)

=== WHAT TO LOOK FOR ===
  # UNCONSTRAINED DELEGATION:
  #   Computer accounts trusted for delegation to ANY service
  #   Attack: Coerce auth (PrinterBug/PetitPotam) -> capture TGT
  # CONSTRAINED DELEGATION:
  #   Accounts delegated to SPECIFIC services (e.g. CIFS/SQL01)
  #   Attack: S4U2Self + S4U2Proxy -> impersonate admin to target
  # RESOURCE-BASED CONSTRAINED (RBCD):
  #   Target allows specific accounts to delegate TO it
  #   Attack: Control source account -> impersonate to target

=== ALTERNATIVE TOOLS ===
  # PowerView:
  Get-DomainComputer -Unconstrained
  Get-DomainUser -TrustedToAuth
  Get-DomainComputer -TrustedToAuth
  # BloodHound: Check delegation edges
  # CrackMapExec:
  crackmapexec ldap <dc_ip> -u <user> -p <pass> --trusted-for-delegation

recommended.note: RBCD attack after finding resource-based delegation targets.
S4U2Self/Proxy attack after finding constrained delegation.
Exploit unconstrained delegation via Kerberos relay.

defense.why_it_works: Delegation settings are stored in AD attributes (userAccountControl, msDS-AllowedToDelegateTo, msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity) readable by any authenticated user.
defense.prerequisites: Any domain user credentials; LDAP access to DC.
defense.impact: Identifies all delegation attack paths in the domain.
defense.detection: [MITRE T1087.002] LDAP queries for delegation attributes; bulk AD enumeration.
defense.artifacts: LDAP queries for userAccountControl with delegation flags; msDS-AllowedToDelegateTo lookups.
defense.splunk_spl:
index=windows EventCode=1644 (SearchFilter="*userAccountControl*" OR SearchFilter="*msDS-AllowedToDelegateTo*")
| table _time, SubjectUserName, SearchFilter
defense.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where EventID == 1644
| where SearchFilter has_any ("AllowedToDelegateTo", "TrustedForDelegation", "AllowedToActOnBehalf")
| project TimeGenerated, SubjectUserName, SearchFilter
defense.prevention: Minimize delegation configurations; use Protected Users group; monitor delegation attribute queries; audit delegation settings regularly.

detections.name: AD delegation enumeration via LDAP
detections.logic:
SecurityEvent
| where EventID == 1644
| where SearchFilter has_any ("msDS-AllowedToDelegateTo", "TrustedForDelegation", "AllowedToActOnBehalf")
| project TimeGenerated, SubjectUserName, ClientIP=IpAddress, SearchFilter
detections.false_positives: BloodHound/SharpHound enumeration; legitimate AD administration tools
detections.tuning: Alert on non-admin accounts querying delegation attributes
